title: The Lost One's Song
text: A song carries on the wind, thin and broken: a House song every child of yours learns at the hearth. Someone is singing it badly, the way a tired person sings to keep from crying. It could be them, or it could be something that heard them.

options.label: Follow the song into the wind, toward whoever is singing it.

outcomes.text: You draw closer. The voice cracks on the same note every time, and you come to dread that note.

options.label: The steadiest voice sings the next verse back to them.

outcomes.text: The song answers stronger, as if whoever sings it has remembered they are not alone.

options.label: Keep silent in case it is a lure; something out here may have learned the song.

outcomes.text: It was no lure. It was one of yours, lost here, and by the time the Leader knows the voice the singing has stopped.
It is a lure, and it is pleased you came so close.
